title: FINDING BALANCE: HOW TO MANAGE NOTIFICATIONS AND AVOID STUDY BURNOUT
excerpt: Studying hard is important, but taking care of your mental health is essential. Learn how to customize your BrainlyHQ notifications, set custom statuses, and take productive breaks to avoid academic burnout. Remember: a well-rested brain always learns faster!
body:
## The Importance of Unplugging

With thousands of messages, study sessions, and questions being posted on BrainlyHQ every day, it is easy to feel like you always need to be online. However, pushing yourself too hard without taking breaks leads straight to study burnout.

Your mental health comes first. To get the most out of our community, you need to know when to engage and when to step back and recharge. Here is how you can use Discord’s features to protect your focus and your free time.

## Tame Your Notifications

You don't need to be alerted about every single math problem or history debate. Customizing your notifications ensures you only see what truly matters to you.

• Mute Unused Channels: Right-click any channel (or an entire category) you don't actively use and select Mute. You can still read them later, but they won't light up your sidebar..

• Server Notification Settings: Click the server name at the top left and go to Notification Settings. We highly recommend setting the default to Only @mentions so you aren't overwhelmed by general chat chatter..

![](/assets/images/blog/jetalproducoes-pen-9960361.png)

## Use Statuses to Set Boundaries

Sometimes you are online but just want to browse quietly or take a break. Let your study group know your availability using your Discord status!

• Do Not Disturb (DND): Setting your status to the red icon stops all desktop and push notifications. It is perfect for deep-focus study sessions or when you just need a nap..

• Custom Status: Click your profile picture to set a custom status. A simple text like "Reading Chapter 4" or "Taking a 30-min break :coffee:" tells the community exactly what you are up to and sets clear boundaries..

## Visit the Chill Channels

BrainlyHQ isn't just for homework! When you need a break from equations and essays, drop by our casual and off-topic channels. Chatting about your favorite video games, sharing pictures of your pets, or just talking about your day is a great way to de-stress and make real friends.

Take a deep breath, adjust your settings, and remember to schedule some downtime today. You've got this!
